title: Terminal Input Field Becomes Unresponsive with Long Text Submissions
body:
**Bug Description**
Submitting long strings, like the output of error messages, console logs, etc. caused the input field to drop off the screen in the terminal, and there was no longer any way to respond, see if anything was happening, etc.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 0.2.9
- Feedback ID: dfdf3b7a-747b-4849-86f7-8f89bf479856
author: virgildotcodes
